findings.summary: The resolved serial queue Promise retained the last decoded Chunk outside the LRU, including after clear. The queue now resolves to undefined.
findings.verification: Directly asserted queue result is undefined both before and after clear without explicit GC

findings.summary: Owned tuple decoding and verification order reduce redundant roots; production portable full verification now runs in a one-shot Utility. Main receives only a checked small receipt, and commit/export/cleanup wait for confirmed Utility exit. Final portable measurements show Main no longer retaining decoded canonical arrays. Total concurrent working-set cost and Renderer release observations remain explicitly disclosed.

Final portable import peak concurrent tracked working-set totals are about 4.40% to 7.90% higher for v2. Most fixtures have one final sample per format; Nuke has three. Working-set totals are simultaneous observations, not sums of independent maxima or PSS.

In one no-fingerprint Nuke control per format, after portable release v2 Renderer working set and used heap remain higher. Direct QA chunks were not inserted into the UI cache, the QA report root was cleared, and Analysis/Verification Utilities exited. Read-only review identified no v2-specific Renderer cache or unbounded strong-reference path. Natural GC timing is a hypothesis, not a proven cause; no claim of complete long-term memory recovery or absence of every leak is made.

nukeNoFingerprintPortableReleasedIdle.interpretation: A labelled observation with no explicit GC or fingerprint allocations. It does not prove a leak, establish a long-term steady state or justify a claim that every process uses less memory.

notClaimed: All processes or all memory metrics improving
Proven natural-GC cause for the remaining Renderer difference
Long-running multi-match memory plateau or complete recovery after every release
Cold physical-disk behavior or cleared OS filesystem cache
Three independent native parses per DEM or a first-import GUI SLA
Installer UI, cross-display DPI or physical power-loss validation
measurementCautions: Exclude strict equivalence fingerprint overhead from production open timing
Use final one-shot-verifier portable samples rather than earlier Main-decoding experiments
Keep the 24 regular GUI samples, final portable probes and two no-fingerprint controls labelled separately
Main/Renderer/Utility simultaneous working-set totals include shared pages and exclude GPU/network; they are not PSS
Distinguish single final samples from the three Nuke portable repetitions
Retain the observed Renderer working-set and heap increase as a cost, not an unproven GC dismissal
New-process first open does not imply cleared OS filesystem cache
Do not use explicit GC to pass production budgets
